description: Two content blocks are an error even when the collection is empty
notes: The README says the generated blocks are read as if they were written in place of the dynamic block, and an empty collection generates none, so this mistake affects no block. Whether a second content block is an error at all is disputed too (see native/dynamic-blocks/content-twice-is-error). hashicorp/hcl counts the content blocks when it reads the dynamic block, before it iterates over the collection (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go).
